- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices during bearish sentiment (negative sentiment < -0.30) — add 3–7% to forecast to compensate for downward bias.
- Overshoot after sharp price spikes — cap forecast 2–3 days after spike at 10–15% below peak.
- Mean-reversion bias: if 3 consecutive forecast days are above 10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 2–5% per day.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment turns positive after 3–5 days, adjust forecast to rise 1–3% per day starting from day 4.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overestimate in early 2025 (post-2024) — apply 3–5% downward correction if sentiment is neutral or mildly bearish.
